name: persistent-current flux qubit, double well tilted by the loop flux
question: Does sweeping the loop flux remove one well of the flux qubit (threshold write), and with which law?
assumptions: barrier fixed in fabrication (beta = 1.6); the loop flux eps tilts the double well
